capabilities: Generate truth tables from a logical expression
Prompt for expressions in a modal
Insert the generated table into the current editor tab
disambiguation: Not a general table editor; it only produces truth tables for logical expressions.
extras: README requires JS logic operators (&&, ||) rather than standard logic symbols, which users may find unexpected; bug reports go through GitHub issues.
motivation: The author built it for quick note taking in logic-related fields.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate truth tables for logic coursework or note taking, so users must fill them in by hand.
summary: Logic tool that generates autofilled truth tables in the editor from a logical expression entered via a command palette modal.
